args.description: Issue #72 deferred tool discovery evaluation. Build the smallest bounded discovery increment on the existing local-agent ToolRegistry. Preserve Direct/Deferred/Hidden separation; expose only deterministic, bounded metadata for Deferred tools; Hidden tools must never appear; discovery must not invoke any executor, mint or bypass LocalAdmission, expand capabilities, or mutate registry state. Keep names/descriptions/schemas within existing ToolSpec limits and avoid host-global paths or secrets in output/debug. Add focused ordering/visibility/bounds/no-execution tests and Windows 2025 + Ubuntu 24.04 validation. Run pinned GitNexus impact/context before edits and staged detect before publication. Do not implement sandboxing, worktrees, snapshots, Hooks, UI, packaging, cloud authority or automatic deferred execution in this issue.

steps.note: 再次调用 start_feature 以生成内嵌 parent-child 规格草稿

globalRules: 首次执行计划时调用 plan_heartbeat 并附完整 plan，建立本地检查点
每完成、跳过或阻塞一个步骤后调用 plan_heartbeat 更新证据与状态
会话中断或切换 Agent 后先调用 resume_plan，再继续未完成步骤
只有 converge 返回 passed=true 后，才能将本次结论正式写入长期记忆
Agent 必须按步骤顺序调用 MCP，并使用宿主能力完成真实文件与代码操作
首次执行前必须用完整 plan 建立 plan_heartbeat 检查点；每完成、跳过或阻断一步立即累计回写
check_spec 未通过前不得进入实现阶段
不得把 delegated plan 的输出误认为代码已经实施
历史记忆仅作为参考，当前项目事实与代码优先
completionCriteria: 规格文档已生成并通过 check_spec
工作量与主要风险已完成评估
Agent 已按 tasks.md 完成实现、测试与代码审查
所有步骤状态与证据已通过 plan_heartbeat 写入检查点
